author: Quaternius
modifications: Only skinned body, no weapon/accessory props. One merged mesh/material; 64px sRGB palette. Bind pivots recovered from glTF inverseBindMatrices (not animated node TRS), world-aligned rest axes and topological joints; skin remapped. Weighted hand vertices verified to lower from T pose. No source combat clips included; local Swift gestures/locomotion.
